name: vibe-audit
description: Agent session auditor for vibe-coding - verifies intent alignment in real-time

scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postbuild:ui: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='ui/dist';const dst='static';if(fs.existsSync(dst))fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Static files copied to /static')"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run postbuild:ui
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:docs-sync && npm run test:backend && npm --prefix ui run build && npm run postbuild:ui && npm run verify:package-smoke
